title: Round-2-Best Reinitialization with Controlled Perturbation
scientific_hypothesis: Reinitializing the optimization population around the round-2 best candidate geometry (target_score 0.9968) with ±4% Gaussian noise and hard 15 nm per-iteration displacement cap will preserve proximity to the high-performing basin while preventing the large thickness swings that caused score regression in rounds 4 and 6.
design_principle: Local refinement around verified high-performing geometry with bounded step sizes to maintain optimizer momentum near the peak without overshooting into lower-performing regions.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si (12 finite layers, alternating high-low index starting with Ta2O5)
soft_objectives: minimize mean reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band
minimize mean reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference optimization
Gradient-based thickness refinement with bounded step sizes prevents overshooting local optima
expected_advantages: Preserves proximity to verified high-performing geometry from round 2
Controlled perturbation prevents large swings that caused regression
Reduced learning-rate decay maintains optimizer momentum near peak
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum without improvement
Restricted step size may slow convergence if broader exploration needed
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 antireflection stack on semi-infinite Si substrate at 0 degree incidence with unpolarized illumination. Initialize all 12 layer thicknesses using round-2-best candidate geometry: [308.36, 233.62, 240.00, 350.28, 257.79, 234.77, 244.33, 332.63, 275.66, 250.70, 115.73, 40.52] nm. Apply ±4% Gaussian noise to create initial population. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with hard per-iteration displacement cap of 15 nm per layer. Reduce adaptive learning-rate decay factor to 0.5x nominal to preserve momentum. Optimize for minimum mean reflectance across both wavelength bands (1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm) with equal weighting. Enforce thickness bounds 20-400 nm per layer. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Directly implements feedback directive to reinitialize around round-2 candidate 2 geometry with ±4% Gaussian noise, 15 nm displacement cap, and reduced learning-rate decay to address score regression observed in rounds 4 and 6.
